description: Removal of existing air conditioning units on flat roof and installation of two new air conditioning units to the rear of the premises.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (002, 003, 004, 005, unnumbered location plan, plant noise assessment and environmental noise survey report- 20/02/20) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The plants hereby approved shall be only operated between 07:00 and 00:00 hours.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the use of the hereby approved condenser units, the noise mitigation measures (acoustic enclosure) shall be installed and put in place, in line with the suggestions within the Acoustic Report.
